goal: Separate the workflow dispatch identity from the applied checkout identity in validateOriginalPreviewApplyEvidence, so a supported merged-main rehearsal dispatched from a later main than the merged commit it checked out is no longer rejected, while every other refusal is preserved.
dispatcher: Owner Albert Hazan authorized resolving open non-orchestrator issues in this repository
prohibited_actions: No migration, database read or write, schema, role, grant, or production command.
Do not weaken the artifact producer check, the source pull request and merge-commit binding, the digest, content manifest, or exact ledger-delta checks.
No hardcoded issue #2509 exception, waiver, or synthetic provenance.
Do not accept an applied checkout that is not proven to lie between the merge commit and the dispatch head.
assumptions: GitHub run.head_sha identifies the commit a workflow_dispatch was started from; the preview instance binding's appliedCommit identifies the commit the run checked out and applied, and the artifact is named for that checkout.
An unavailable or non-lineal commit comparison must answer 'not proven', so a caller without io.compareCommits keeps the existing same-commit behaviour only.
Issue #2781 is already delivered on main by merged PR #2780; this contract covers issue #2549 only.
stop_conditions: Stop if the supported merged-main tuple cannot be expressed without relaxing source-PR or merge-commit provenance.
Stop if any existing positive or negative preview-evidence regression changes verdict.
